investment_strategy: Cautiously bullish, quality-first AI exposure. With VIX ~23 and 10Y ~4.3%, prioritize resilient, cash-generative platforms and a single best-in-class semiconductor enabler. Overweight Microsoft for lower volatility and diversified AI monetization (cloud, enterprise), complement with Alphabet for high-growth platform momentum, and add ASML as a pick-and-shovel beneficiary of datacenter AI capex. Keep sizing conservative on policy-sensitive names. Enter in 2–3 tranches over 4–6 weeks, rebalance quarterly, and trim if single-position weight >55% or if any name faces material regulatory/export-control shocks.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Chosen for the combination of lower-to-moderate volatility (vs. peers), strong earnings/revenue growth, favorable momentum, and positive analyst consensus; weights reflect macro (VIX 23, rates ~4.3%), regulatory/export-control exposure, and need to diversify across AI platforms and enablers.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Cautiously bullish on AI-driven tech. Secular demand for accelerators, memory, and cloud AI persists, while policy and antitrust risks warrant a quality bias and measured sizing.
